title: Ramps — special tiles bridging adjacent cells with height delta=1, bomber smoothly walks up/down
intent: Builds on GDP-2026-05-28-010 (variable height). A `Ramp` component on a cell bridges two adjacent cells whose heights differ by 1 — bomber walking through the ramp tile smoothly transitions Y from fromHeight to toHeight. Ramps make CLIFFS PASSABLE in controlled spots — arena authors place ramps where they want bombers to access high ground. Without ramps, cliffs are walls. Pathfinding (bot AI + agent.gotoCell BFS) extends to know that ramp cells are traversable across the height delta. Visual: wedge mesh tilted between the two heights. Closes the height system's gameplay loop — players can NOW reach the high ground from GDP-010's plateau prototype.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/terrain-design.md §2.3` + dependency on GDP-2026-05-28-010 (cells with Height + Cliff blocking). Ramps unlock the actual gameplay — without them, GDP-010 ships impassable plateaus. Pair seq: 010 ships foundation + visual + cliff-block; 011 ships ramps + traversal + first usable height-aware arena.
acceptanceHints: DEPENDS ON: GDP-2026-05-28-010 (Height + Cliff + cuboid mesh). Cannot ship before.
SCHEMA — examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json (or engine/grid/components/):
Ramp component:
fromHeight: integer (the lower cell's H)
toHeight: integer (the higher cell's H = fromHeight + 1)
direction: 'N' | 'E' | 'S' | 'W' (the direction the ramp 'climbs to' — from-cell is to the OPPOSITE direction)
Ramp lives on a cell that is BETWEEN two cells of different heights. Ramp cell's OWN height = fromHeight (the ramp starts low, ends high at the to-cell).
v1 constraint: ramp connects cells with delta == 1 only. Steeper traversal = multi-cell ramp series, each delta=1.
CLIFF SUPPRESSION — when a Ramp connects cells A + B:
CliffComputeSystem from GDP-010 sees the Ramp + DOES NOT spawn a Cliff marker between A and B. Edge is passable.
Other adjacent cells of A and B still get cliff markers as normal.
GRID OCCUPANCY EXTENSION:
Movement validation (bomber attempts traversal from A to B): if A and B are connected via Ramp → traversal ALLOWED (overrides any height-delta check).
Otherwise: height-delta still blocks per GDP-010 cliff rule.
RAMP TRAVERSAL SYSTEM (new):
When a bomber's GridMover starts a cell-tween onto/off a Ramp:
1. Identify the FROM and TO cell heights via the ramp's component.
2. During cell-tween (existing 1-cell move animation at GridMover.speed): write Transform.position.y = lerp(fromHeight, toHeight, currentLerp). Bomber's Y rises smoothly with their X/Z movement.
3. At cell-tween end, snap Y to toHeight + walk continues onto the next cell at that height.

Edge case: bomber on ramp cell standing still → Y = (fromHeight + toHeight)/2 (centred). Or snap to fromHeight (ramp 'start')? Design pick: SNAP TO MIDPOINT — bomber visually appears 'on the ramp slope'.
RAMP MESH (procedural builder):
examples/kaboom-crew/src/blocks/ramp-builder.ts: `buildRampMesh(fromH, toH, direction)` returns a wedge BufferGeometry.

Wedge shape: 1×1×1 BoxGeometry deformed — 4 corners at the from-side are at Y=fromH (1 cell square base footprint), 4 corners at the to-side at Y=toH. Top surface is the inclined plane. Side faces are 2 triangles each.
Top surface uses floor Wang tile material (so ramps participate in floor terrain look).
Side faces use cliff-face material from GDP-010.
Ramp can also have a thin EDGE strip (cream stripe) along the top sides — telegraphs 'walkable surface' to player.
PATHFINDING EXTENSION (bot AI + agent.gotoCell BFS S82):
Graph edges include ramp connections — A → B is reachable if cell A and B are connected by a Ramp.

Edge weight: ramps cost slightly MORE than flat traversal (e.g. 1.2× the GridMover dt) because ramp tween is a smidge longer than flat (the diagonal-ish path). Optional polish; equal weight works for v1.
Bot AI sees ramp cells as 'travel cost' cells — uses them to reach high ground when goal cell is up there.
DANGER MAP + BLAST INTERACTION:

Bomb on a cliff edge with ramp below: blast walks across the ramp into the lower cells (the ramp connects them as 'same elevation traversal' for blast purposes — wait, the blast was cliff-blocked per GDP-010). RESOLVED RULE: Ramps SUPPRESS the cliff for both movement AND blast. A bomb at cell A (H=0) walks blast through the ramp to cell B (H=1) — blast can climb a single ramp step. Beyond that ramp step, the blast continues at H=1 if the next cells are H=1 (or hits a cliff again).
This is consistent: ramps are 'no cliff here' bridges.
Optional simpler rule: blast walks XZ as 2D, ignoring height entirely once a ramp connection exists. Implementations: cliffless edge means blast continues. Either rule works; pick the consistent one.
CAMERA INTERACTION:
Camera follow from S163 + GDP-010 extension: Y lerps as bomber's Y changes. Walking up a ramp = camera smoothly rises with bomber. No special handling needed.
PROTOTYPE ARENA (replace GDP-010's cliffside arena):

Update `examples/kaboom-crew/scenes/cliffside.scene.json` from GDP-010 — add TWO ramp cells connecting the central plateau (H=2) to the surrounding floor (H=0). Ramps placed on opposite corners of the plateau. Each ramp = H=0 base cell → H=1 ramp cell → H=2 plateau cell (multi-cell ramp series since plateau is +2 and ramps are +1 max each).
Bombers can now climb the plateau. Tactical: 1 bomber can defend the plateau by bombing the ramp entry; another bomber must time their ramp ascent.
MULTIPLAYER:
Server's pathfinding + GridOccupancy mirrors the ramp logic. Snapshot Transform.position.y already in protocol from GDP-010.
BOT AI PERSONALITY HOOK (forward-compat, not in scope here):
Future hook: Coward bot prefers high-ground (defensive); Hunter bot rushes to low-ground enemies via ramps. Out of scope; just note the design opportunity in code comments.
TESTS:
Cell A (H=0) and cell B (H=1) connected by Ramp → bomber walks A → ramp → B, Y smoothly lerps during the tween, lands at H=1 on B.
Without the ramp: same scenario → bomber stops at the cliff (per GDP-010).
Pathfinding: bot pathing from H=0 corner to H=2 plateau uses 2-step ramp chain, doesn't try to walk straight up the cliff.
Blast from H=0 walks through a ramp to H=1, stops at next-cliff between H=1 and H=2.
Camera lerps Y when bomber walks up the ramp.
VISUAL QA:
Ramp mesh renders as a wedge, not a flat tile.
Bomber stands on the inclined surface during ramp tween — not floating, not clipping.
Bomber facing direction visible on ramp (smooth-rotation S157 works through ramp tween).
OUT OF SCOPE:
Multi-height ramps (delta > 1 in a single ramp cell). v1: single-step only.
Diagonal ramps (NE, SE, etc). 4-cardinal only.
Ramp that's also a Conveyor / Warp / Pressure Plate cell — single hazard role per cell.
Ramps in solo mode being optional. Same in both modes.
Visualised "ramp arrow" overlay telegraphing direction. The wedge shape is the visual.
Stair-step ramps (multi-segment within one cell). Smooth ramp only.
